q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a plastic lunch box?
title: Plastic lunch box carbon footprint per box
short: Weigh each box and lid, multiply the PP or other resin by the supplier's figure, and add seals and any steel containers inside. Add moulding and assembly energy, then divide the plant's energy by boxes made.

ul: Steel inner containers in some models.

p: Report per box by capacity and weight.

example.title: Worked example: plant energy per box (one month)
lines: Plant total: 35,500 / 200,000 = 0.177 kg CO2 per box
Add resin and any steel parts for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
